metadata.name: dfly
metadata.description: DFlash shared-FC context plus a per-layer fusion residual and an optional zero-init SwiGLU hidden-states correction conditioned on the previous token (DFlareV2).

evidence.evidence: R-20261014-11 E4 canonical 2K upstream_two_stage recipe (AL 1.839 vs controlled_ce 1.682, 128/128 exact; configs/dfly/qwen2_5_vl_3b_2k_recipe.yaml); zoo-v0.3.2 archive + demo reload

training_signals.hard_label: Yes - decayed block CE by default; under the recipe, D-PACE-weighted block CE in stage 2 (stage 1 is LK-only, no CE).
training_signals.context_layers: context_layer_ids with per-layer fusion + the hidden-states correction (upstream recipe: [1,9,17,25,33]; matched 3-layer variant: [1,17,33]).
training_signals.teacher_final_hidden: Recipe only - train_recipe: upstream_two_stage consumes the target's final hidden states in both stages (LK and e2e TV).
training_signals.distribution_objective: Under the recipe: LK hybrid (KL/TV blend) cold start, then the end-to-end multi-step TV term.
training_signals.confidence_objective: None as a trained head; D-PACE confidences are detached position weights derived from the CE.
training_signals.stage: Single stage by default; the recipe switches cold_start_lk_dpace -> e2e_tv.
training_signals.block_convention: Forced DFlash convention (sample_from_anchor=false regardless of the YAML value).

runtime_note: Trained with this repo's port of upstream AngelSpec's two-stage recipe (objective_profile=upstream_two_stage: LK / D-PACE cold start -> end-to-end TV; see docs/upstream/dfly.md). At inference the block backbone runs in parallel, then the hidden-states correction and the LM-head projection run per slot sequentially, conditioned on the previously proposed tokens -- the documented local adaptation of upstream's train-time-only correction transformation.
